Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum age to register?

Most distances require participants to be 18 and above on race day; shorter fun run categories may allow younger participants with guardian consent. Check the specific race options above.

What is the refund/cancellation policy?

Registration fees are generally non-refundable but often transferable to another runner or deferred to the next edition — confirm directly with the organizer.

Is there a cut-off time?

Yes, most distances have a cut-off time to ensure route safety and marshal availability — see Course Details above for specifics per distance.

What should I bring on race day?

Bib number, valid ID, comfortable running gear, and your own hydration for longer distances is recommended in addition to water stations on route.
